amendment.reason: The first formal run stopped at update 7 only because the shared LocalSafetyCallback treated five consecutive completion-clipping ratios above 0.10 as a hard stop. The frozen plan and Windows guide declared non-finite loss, repeated very slow steps, and five zero-within-group-variance updates as hard stops; completion clipping was intended to remain a dashboard diagnostic. Updates 1-7 had finite loss and gradient norm, nonzero reward variance, stable entropy, and 66-89 second step times.
amendment.change: Stage-A completion clipping remains logged but is diagnostic-only. All scientific settings, generation length, data, seeds, learning rates, budgets, checkpoint grid, and execution geometry are unchanged.
amendment.supersedes: execution only; the original plan, config, stopped run, and commit 580f0e1 remain immutable evidence
